plugins.name: fdeops
plugins.description: Engagement memory for AI coding agents. One entry point that routes by situation (land, discover, build, rescue, ship, close), does the phase work, and keeps per-client memory - sponsor, promise, decision, acceptance, dated - in local .fde/ files. For Forward Deployed Engineers running several clients at once; healthcare, fintech, and government overlays included.
